options.label: Branch in place: `git switch -c feature/session-preserve-toolkit`
options.description: Keeps changes, just moves them off main. Simplest — no new directory, this session continues in the same cwd. main stays clean. Good if you trust this session's transcript to stay coherent.

options.label: New worktree: stash → add worktree → unstash there
options.description: `git stash -u`, `git worktree add ../ai-harness-session-preserve feature/session-preserve-toolkit`, then unstash there. I keep working but in the new dir. Closer to the project convention but the transcript's cwd changes mid-session, which may confuse the fork tooling later.

options.label: Just branch now, leave the rest for me to decide
options.description: Same as option 1 — minimum action. Skip the worktree question; commit + push happens later when YOU say so.
